productConcept.name: Flora Carta
productConcept.tagline: Twelve plates. One season. The living archive.
productConcept.description: A London-based subscription archive of hand-painted botanical illustration folios — twelve original plates per season in period-accurate gouache, watercolour, or copperplate, printed on Hahnemühle archival paper and delivered as bound specimen folios. Founded 2019. 1,400 active subscribers in 47 countries.
productConcept.rationale: The Art Nouveau botanical luxury aesthetic — Playfair Display italic, warm gold + deep sage, salon grid layouts, Dancing Script ornamental, grand 1600px editorial canvas — maps directly onto the illustrated natural history folio form, which was the defining luxury publication of the Art Nouveau period (1890–1910). The folio as an object (cloth-bound, gold-foil titled, slip-cased) mirrors the salon-framed card aesthetic of the design system exactly. Botanical illustration as 'slow art' matches the languid 0.75–1.43s organic motion vocabulary (vine-grow, petal-unfurl, tendril-rise). The Chelsea Physic Garden connection grounds the concept in real institutional heritage rather than invented copy.

animationDecision: motion-tokens — non-trivial durations 0.75–1.43s, named botanical easing curves (vineGrow, petalUnfurl, tendrilRise, goldShimmer, revealSweep), scroll references in concept_by_video.md

keyDesignDecisions: Ghost letterforms in Playfair Display italic on every page header (opacity 0.06 teal stroke) — matches Art Nouveau decorative lettering tradition
salon-framed component: CSS ::before/::after corner brackets in gold (24×24px L-brackets) on all image frames — specimen label aesthetic
3 video placements as per concept_by_video.md: hand-dye-process (index hero), loom-weave-rhythm (index craft section), botanical-studio (editions header)
Ticker band in #092222 with gold Dancing Script text — functional information band, not decoration
Drop cap in Playfair Display italic gold on first about.html paragraph — fin-de-siècle publication convention
Pull quote float:right 38% with 3px gold left border on about.html — Cormorant Garamond italic 1.45rem
Wax seal device in footer: circular border with 'Est. 2019' Dancing Script text, goldShimmer animation on scroll
SVG section dividers: 5 distinct organic shapes across pages (wave, double-wave, irregular cliff, blade cuts, jagged mountain) — each geometrically distinct
